ticker_news.title: OpenAI's Annualized Revenue Skyrockets Beyond $25 Billion: Report
ticker_news.description: OpenAI has surpassed $25 billion in annualized revenue as of February 2026, representing a 17% increase from the previous year's $21.4 billion. Despite impressive growth, the company faces intensifying competition from Anthropic, which is targeting a 180% revenue increase. OpenAI received significant funding from SoftBank, Amazon, and Nvidia, with Nvidia's CEO suggesting their $30 billion investment may be the last before OpenAI's anticipated IPO later in 2026.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: Broadcom Gains as AI Chip Outlook Points to $100B Revenue Path by 2027
ticker_news.description: Broadcom shares surged 7% in premarket trading after CEO Hock Tan announced the company has clear visibility to exceed $100 billion in AI chip sales by 2027, up from $20 billion in 2025. The company secured major partnerships with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta, and announced a $10 billion share repurchase program. Despite the positive outlook, Broadcom faces competition from Nvidia, which is expected to generate around $333 billion in AI data center revenue in fiscal 2027.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Fries

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq Futures Decline As Iran War Escalates— Trade Desk, Webull, Broadcom In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Thursday following geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, with reports of Iran initiating contact with Trump for ceasefire negotiations. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 fell slightly in premarket trading. Notable movers included Broadcom surging 6.66% on better-than-expected Q1 results, Veeva Systems rising 11.32% on strong guidance, Trade Desk jumping 16.85% following insider buying, and Webull falling 3.13% after missing profit targets.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
